links.outcome: Registered dietitians' depth of understanding of the ML tool across hospitals and levels
links.effect: Depth of tool understanding varied by hospital and level among 17 interviewed registered dietitians; continuous stakeholder involvement at new sites was judged vital given staff turnover.
links.quote: (5) depth of tool understanding varied by hospital and level;

unlisted_practices: Continuous stakeholder involvement at new sites to maintain buy-in despite staff turnover
Using qualitative research to identify potential bias of ML tools
Making iterative enhancements to the tool based on end-user feedback

screen.reason: This is a qualitative post-implementation evaluation examining clinicians' experiences using an ML malnutrition screening tool in real-world practice, but it does not compare outcomes with vs. without a specific safeguard or deployment practice.
